arms.description: Concise instructions plus targeted search, no worker delegation

The client's own built-in discovery or exploration agent, where one exists. Beating an unoptimized baseline is a low bar that concise instructions alone may clear; this arm answers whether the feature beats what the client already does for free.

cache_state_policy: Declared by the harness, never inferred. Cold compares only against cold and warm only against warm. When the harness cannot establish it, record 'unknown' and exclude that run from cache-sensitive comparisons rather than guessing. Randomised order distributes cache error, it does not remove it.

workspace_isolation.rule: The harness constructs a scratch workspace per run containing only the fixture's evidence/ directory plus task.md. criteria.json, capability.txt, manifest.json, and every other fixture are outside it. Passing only task.md as a prompt is NOT isolation — an agent that can read the repository can read the answer key.

acceptance_goals.note: Goals for a pilot, not measured results. Nothing in this repository has been benchmarked.
acceptance_goals.correctness_regression: no OBSERVED regression across the runs performed; three runs per arm cannot establish absence of a regression, so any published result states the run count next to the claim

cost_model.note: Fields are mutually exclusive per actor per billing unit, each counted exactly once. Retries are NOT a cost field: a retry produces its own token counts inside the actor that retried, so adding retries again double-counts. retries is an integer for diagnosis only.
cost_model.actor_cost: sum over billing units of (tokens * rate for that unit at pricing_date)
cost_model.reduction: 1 - optimized total / baseline total, only when baseline > 0
